name: Ula'elek
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Ula'elek forges armor for warriors across the Horde. This Darkspear smith works with Thun'grim Firegaze, shaping specialized gear through traditional troll craft and trophies gathered across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Smith of the Darkspear
sections.body: Ula'elek serves the Darkspear as an armorsmith in Sen'jin Village. Nearby quilboar and sea crawlers threaten the coastal settlement, so the tribe needs sturdy armor and sound blades. Ula'elek's skill also brings seasoned warriors from across the Horde to his forge.

sections.title: Forging the Brutal Armor
sections.body: Young warriors who visit Thun'grim Firegaze at his overlook in the Barrens are sent south to Sen'jin Village. The veteran trusts Ula'elek to forge Brutal Gauntlets for battle-hardened fighters. The work calls for rare materials, especially swollen, uncloven hooves from the satyrs draining the forest's magic in northeastern Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Ula'elek is a Darkspear troll armorsmith in Sen'jin Village. Horde veterans trust him to make specialized armor for promising frontline fighters.
Ula'elek can be found in Sen'jin Village on Durotar's southeastern coast, south of Razor Hill.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim Firegaze send warriors to Ula'elek?
faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to Ula'elek because he trusts the troll smith to forge Brutal Gauntlets for warriors who have earned his respect.

faq.q: What materials does Ula'elek need to make the gauntlets?
faq.answer: Ula'elek needs warriors to hunt satyrs in northeastern Ashenvale and gather their swollen, uncloven hooves for the Brutal Gauntlets.

faq.q: What kind of gear does Ula'elek craft?
faq.answer: Ula'elek specializes in heavy combat armor. He makes the Brutal Gauntlets, part of the Brutal Armor set for promising Horde warriors.

faq.q: Why do the gauntlets require satyr hooves?
faq.answer: Satyrs in northeastern Ashenvale drain the forest's magic, and the most potent among them have swollen, uncloven hooves. Ula'elek draws power from those hooves and puts it into the gauntlets.

angles.text: As a warrior, you rely on Ula'elek to forge your Brutal armor set. At Thun'grim Firegaze's direction, he shapes hard-won satyr hooves into rugged gauntlets.
As a troll, you see Darkspear smiths equipping the young Horde with frontline gear on Sen'jin Village's open shores.
As a blacksmith, you see Horde smiths turn beast and demon trophies to practical use in warrior armor, beyond traditional foundries.
